parameters.content:
## START HERE: Housecall Pro CSV-First Morning Ops Copilot (DRAFT v0.1.0)
The CSV path is the product. Export your Jobs (and, if you can, Invoices and Estimates) from Housecall Pro as CSV, get them into n8n, and get one Morning Ops digest (unscheduled / late / needs-office-action jobs, ready-to-invoice and past-due, stalled high-value estimates) to the OWNER only.

**Housecall Pro Open API and webhooks are MAX-only and are NOT used in v0.1.** A Basic or Essentials shop needs no plan upgrade for this workflow.

**Test it in about 2 minutes:**
1. Imported inactive. The webhook, email, and schedule triggers are switched off.
2. testMode is on and **source** defaults to test, which is fictional sample data for Cedar Creek Plumbing & Air (fixtures/sample-hcp-export-*.csv). Click **Execute workflow** on Manual Test Run. You get a [TEST] digest.
3. Compare with sample_morning_digest.md in the pack.
4. Set source = csv, put your own exports in csvFolder, run again. Still [TEST].
5. Only then enable one trigger. See the go-live note.

Status: DRAFT. Workflow JSON and Code nodes checked locally with fictional data. NOT tested against a live Housecall Pro, Gmail, or Slack account.

## Config fields
- **source**: test (built-in fictional sample, default) | csv (read your exports). An upload that arrives by webhook or email is always treated as csv. There is no live Housecall Pro source in this file.
- **testMode**: ON by default. Messages are labeled [TEST]. source = test always forces it on.
- **delivery**: email | slack | both | none. Owner only.
- **ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel**: YOUR address and a private channel. Never a customer. Read from this Config node only, never from an uploaded row or email header.
- **csvFolder**: watch folder for manual and scheduled runs. n8n only reads files inside its allowed folder. The Read node reads every .csv in it.
- **asOfOverride**: ISO time to pretend it is a different moment, for an export from earlier. Blank = now.
- **pastDueMinDays** (1), **estimateStalledDays** (blank until configured; set it after the last follow-up your shop sends on its own), **estimateMinValue** (1000): starting points, not industry standards.
- The scheduled run uses Config source, so set source = csv before you enable the schedule.

## Safety defaults
- Imported **inactive**. The Schedule, Webhook, and Email-attachment triggers are all **disabled**.
- **testMode** ON; source = **test** (fictional sample).
- **Zero Housecall Pro write-back**: this file never calls Housecall Pro at all. It only reads the CSV you give it. There is no HTTP Request node.
- **Owner-only output**: Gmail and Slack recipients come from ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel. No SMS, no Twilio, no customer email, no review request, no reminder blast.
- The email trigger only READS an inbound message. It does not reply, label, or forward.
- The webhook expects a header-auth credential (placeholder). Never expose it without one.
- The stalled-estimate list is for a human call or personal note.
- Never invents numbers. A missing report or column becomes a "Heads-up" line.

## CSV intake (every Housecall Pro plan, no API key, no MAX)
**Export:** a Housecall Pro admin can export Jobs to CSV; the file is emailed to the admin. That manual Jobs export is the verified part. Whether Invoices and Estimates exports exist on your plan, and the exact column names, have NOT been verified; the pack matches common names loosely. Any one report is enough; a missing one becomes a Heads-up.
**Required columns:** Jobs: Job #, Status. Invoices: Invoice #, Status, Due date, Amount due (or Balance). Estimates: Estimate #, Status, Total, Sent date. A missing one produces a plain-language Heads-up that names it and lists the headers seen, not a crash.
**Finished jobs need an invoice check:** provide an explicit Invoice status on the Jobs row or a matching Invoices row with a recognized status.
**Dates** like 3/10/2026 9:50 AM are shop-local in the Config timezone. Impossible dates (2026-02-30) and unclosed quotes are reported, never silently accepted.
**Three ways in:** (1) Webhook: POST the file(s) as multipart field "data". (2) Email attachment from an allowed sender set in the Gmail trigger query. (3) Watch folder: drop the files in csvFolder.
Housecall Pro Open API and webhooks are MAX-only and are not used in v0.1.

## Credentials (placeholders only)
PLACEHOLDER_GMAIL (inbound email trigger and owner email), PLACEHOLDER_SLACK, PLACEHOLDER_WEBHOOK_HEADER_AUTH (webhook). No Housecall Pro credential is used or needed. No secrets are stored in this file.

## Hard stop before go-live
Do not turn testMode off or enable a trigger until: (1) a clean [TEST] run from the sample export, (2) a clean [TEST] run from YOUR exports, spot-checked by hand against Housecall Pro, (3) ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel confirmed as owner-only, (4) the Gmail query limited to one sender you trust and the webhook behind header auth, (5) an owner has signed off in writing. Even live, this workflow only reports to the owner. Not tested against a live Housecall Pro, Gmail, or Slack account.
